defs.def: directed or moving towards the back 向后的；朝后的

ex.s: As renowned tech innovator Steve Jobs once said, “You can’t connect the dots looking forward; you can only connect them looking backwards.
ex.t: 在拍照时，我注意到大家都很高兴。

ex.s: Like the writer, all we can do is look backwards “with a sigh” and imagine what could have been.
ex.t: 当他听说这个情况时，他以为女孩们只是有点孤单。

ex.s: Oddly, many of these notes are written backwards: You have to hold them up to the mirror in order to read them.
ex.t: 我正要放弃时，我哥哥给了我一把钥匙。

ex.s: For life goes not backward nor tarries with yesterday.
ex.t: 虽然那些不太成功的人往往属于这个群体，但其实任何人都有可能遭受厄运。

ex.s: I pushed the starting lever on the main panel forwards an inch then immediately backwards again.
ex.t: 把……附在上面\/我在每一个字母上都附上一个小磁铁字母，把大的金属星星附在玩具上。

defs.def: moving in a direction that means that no progress is being made 倒退的；反向的
having made less progress than normal; developing slowly 落后的；进步缓慢的

ex.s: Even if this method of timekeeping is novel in its particulars，early agricultural societies also connected time to natural phenomena．In pre-Classical Greece，for instance，people“corrected”official calendars by shifting dates forward or backward to reflect the change of season．Temporal connection to the environment was vital to their survival．Likewise，river time and other timekeeping systems we're developing may encourage environmental awareness．
ex.t: 即使这种计时方法的具体细节是新颖的早期农业社会也将时间与自然现象联系起来．例如在前古典希腊时期人们通过向前或向后调整日期来"修正"官方历法以反映季节的变化．与环境的时间联系对他们的生存至关重要．同样河流时间和其他我们正在开发的计时系统可能会促进环保意识．
